summary.motive: Pair a downhill duo run fake with a free backside crosser to punish linebackers and cornerbacks who trigger on run action.
summary.whyItWorks: Every second-level defender steps downhill into a double team that physically occupies them, and the run-triggering cornerback vacates the crosser entirely; X crosses behind all of it with no defender assigned to him.
summary.failureMode: A quarterback-spiering safety who plays half-field eyes-through-the-QB can rob the crosser, and an apex who refuses the downhill bait keeps his zone integrity intact.

beats.title: Downhill Trigger
beats.text: The identical stretch look pulls every second-level defender one more step right — MIKE shoots B-gap and WILL fills hard, both with their eyes on backfield rather than the crossing pattern developing behind them.

beats.title: Double Team Forms, Crosser Releases Free
beats.text: TE folds inside and the RT/TE combo buries the SDE while X releases untouched behind the downhill linebackers — the LCB has already abandoned him for a run fit that doesn't exist.

beats.title: Crosser Behind the Second Level
beats.text: X levels across at four yards exactly where the linebackers used to be; SAM recognizes it last because he was fitting the edge of the double team, and his recovery angle is already lost.

beats.title: Window Throw Over Traffic
beats.text: The QB delivers from a clean launch point created by the center's seal — the ball arrives before FS can break and while H's stalk keeps the sky safety pinned away from the catch point.

relations.tell: The RB plants downhill instead of pressing the perimeter — OL blockers converge into a vertical double team rather than washing laterally.
